### Hardware Issue Description
Provide technical details of the electrical or sensor issue.

### Affected Components
- [ ] MQ-135 Gas Sensor
- [ ] DHT22 Humidity/Temp Sensor
- [ ] I2C Bus / PCF8574 Backpack
- [ ] Piezo Buzzer / Driver Circuit
- [ ] Pushbutton / Debounce Circuit
- [ ] Power Regulation Rail (5V/GND)

### Measurement Data & Observations
- Measured Voltage / Current:
- Oscilloscope / Multimeter readings:
- Noise / Ripple observed:

### Root Cause Investigation Method
- [ ] 5-Why Analysis
- [ ] Ishikawa (Fishbone) Diagram

### Corrective & Preventive Action (CAPA)
Hardware modifications or firmware safeguards required.
